conflicts.002_003_005_006_008_009: Three naming sets exist for the same slots: (A) ROSTER (current in-repo): 002 Tiidebiite, 003 AquariiOS, 005 Chromejaww, 006 Reaperdile, 008 Duneclaw, 009 Oblivirex. (B) ORIGINAL pasted evolutions (computer/OS vibe, AI-invented in that chat): 002 Tidebyte, 003 Aquari-OS, 005 Chromedile (also the species.ts name), 006 Dreadgator, 008 Duneclaw, 009 Oblivirex. (C) REFORGED pasted evolutions (classic monster-tamer vibe, explicitly replacing B): 002 Mochiimander, 003 Leviatide, 005 Steelmaw, 006 Titanjaw, 008 Terraraptor, 009 Cataclysr. Mars has NOT confirmed in this chat which set is canon. Descriptions for B and C are both saved below, tagged by version, so nothing is lost whichever set he picks. Element conflicts: B 002 Aqua/Core vs roster Aqua/Mythic; B 006 Chrome/Umbral vs roster Chrome/Strike; B 008 Core/Bone (Bone is not in the 12 True Elements, not in roster's 15) vs roster Core/Umbral.
conflicts.046: Yogiferno: paste says type shifts to Mythic on final evolution; roster keeps Flame/Mythic for all three primate stages. Treat as Flame/Mythic throughout unless Mars says otherwise.

direction: Pokemon-style 2D/2.5D, NOT voxel. Base starters are settled; starter EVOLUTION NAMES are an open three-way conflict — see conflicts section. Do NOT rename the roster on the basis of this file.
